lines.1: 「Come on, wake up, Leo. It's morning.」
lines.3: 「If you keep refusing to listen, your big sis is going to get a little rough. You okay with that?」
lines.5: 「You really didn't want to wake up today. You went straight to bed yesterday too. You went to school all three days of the long weekend, so I guess you're tired...」
lines.7: 「Just power through today on sheer spirit.」
lines.8: 「When you get home, I'll give you a massage until you've had more than enough. It'll work the fatigue right out of you.」
lines.10: 「We're out of time. I'm heading on ahead. I left rice balls on the table for you.」
